title: setSlippageTolerance allows up to MAX_BPS (100%), letting an owner set minOut=0 and drain shares via withdrawAsOwner / withdrawFrom

classification.assetImpact: A malicious or compromised owner can set slippageTolerance to 100%, accept minOut=0 on every swap, and effectively burn arbitrary shares for ~zero return.

justification: Owner-only attack vector. Per project conventions, owner-power-only findings are tagged as Centralization. Recommendation: cap slippageTolerance at a sane upper bound (e.g. 10% or 5% MAX_BPS) and use a strict < check.
